purpose: Replay the geometry-gate cross-domain compromise, the density-ratio lensing sequence, the reversed-orientation galaxy result, and a mass-gate control with eight lens-geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the geometry-gate bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when RMS over surviving roots is small.
The replay was selected after viewing two-start results and is a numerical robustness test, not an independent holdout.
